Our team of experts are dedicated to providing personalised guidance, helping you find the perfect tyres for your vehicle. Enjoy fast and efficient tyre fitting services, ensuring you're back on the road in no time. Discover the difference quality car tyres can make. Visit us today! Our experienced technicians are dedicated to precision and quality, ensuring your engine runs smoothly and efficiently. With decades of experience, we guarantee a well-done job, every time. We use only the best parts and tools for a reliable, long-lasting repair. A well-maintained cam belt improves fuel efficiency and reduces costs. Don't risk engine damage. Schedule your replacement today. We'll provide a detailed inspection and quote, so you can make an informed decision. Enquire Now Call 01332 342 002 DPF cleaning Derby Tired of DPF issues? Our advanced cleaning solution is here to help. We use cutting-edge technology to meticulously remove soot and contaminants, preventing costly repairs and ensuring optimal engine performance. Invest in your vehicle's health today and experience the difference a clean DPF can make. Our expert technicians are dedicated to providing top-notch DPF cleaning services, ensuring your engine runs smoothly and efficiently. Don't let DPF issues hold you back. Contact us today for a consultation and let us restore your vehicle's performance Book an Appointment Call 01332 342 002 Hybrid EV servicing Derby Maintaining a hybrid vehicle is akin to caring for a traditional car, but with a few additional considerations. Our expert technicians are not only proficient in handling standard maintenance procedures but also possess a deep understanding of the unique intricacies of hybrid technology. They are equipped to address the specific needs of your hybrid vehicle, ensuring its optimal performance and longevity. By entrusting your hybrid to our skilled technicians, you can rest assured that it is receiving the highest quality care, tailored to its specific requirements. Schedule your hybrid service today and experience the peace of mind that comes with knowing your vehicle is in the hands of true experts. Our technicians are dedicated to providing exceptional care for your hybrid, utilising the latest diagnostic equipment and adhering to manufacturer guidelines. By choosing our services, you're investing in the long-term health and performance of your vehicle. Don't compromise on the care your hybrid deserves. Book an Appointment Call 01332 342 002 Derby garage 252 Abbey St Derby DE22 3SW 01332 342 002 derby@kamservicing.com Manager : Ashley Wallace Mon-Fri : 7.30am - 5.30pm Sat : 7.45am - 2.00pm Sun : Closed Get in touch Email us using the form below. Send message Where can I find KAM Servicing in Derby? We're conveniently located in Derby South, specifically in the Abbey Street area, which is part of the Abbey ward. Our location puts us within easy walking distance of the city center, where you'll find a vibrant mix of shops, restaurants, and entertainment. If you're a student at the University of Derby, we're also nearby. And for those who enjoy the outdoors, we're surrounded by beautiful green spaces like Derby Arboretum and Markeaton Park. Whether you live in the area or are just visiting, we're here to offer you exceptional service. Book an Appointment Call 01332 342 002 Why choose KAM Servicing? Trusted for over 30 years, we're a family-run garage with a 4.5-star Google rating. Specialising in all makes and models, we offer MOT testing, car servicing, and expert repairs like air conditioning, diagnostics, and clutch work. Enjoy a friendly atmosphere and competitive prices. Call 01332 342 002 to book your appointment. Our highly trained technicians use state-of-the-art equipment to deliver top-quality service. Customer satisfaction is our priority, and we're dedicated to going above and beyond for you.
